relationships.subject: sildenafil-metformin combination
relationships.evidence_quote: Moreover, all sildenafil-metformin combinations significantly reduced the concentration of nitrites in the brain and liver, which are final products formed under the action of iNOS.

relationships.subject: sildenafil-metformin combination
relationships.evidence_quote: The combination of these two substances increased the pain reaction latency of diabetic animals in a dose-dependent manner.

key_findings: Sildenafil-metformin combinations increased pain latencies and lowered glycemia and nitrites in alloxan diabetic mice
Combinations did not reduce TNF-α in brain and liver
